resources.string: Blocks YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and distracting feeds automatically.

NoScroll uses the Accessibility Service to detect when short-form video players (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Snapchat Spotlights, etc.) or restricted websites are opened so it can exit the player or enforce your focus plan. All inspection happens locally on your device.
Protects NoScroll from unauthorized uninstallation while Uninstall Protection is active.
Keeps short-video detection and daily scroll limits active in the background.
